survey.title: Membership Inference Attacks on Machine Learning: A Survey
Membership Inference Attacks and Defenses in Federated Learning: A Survey
Membership Inference Attacks on Large-Scale Models: A Survey

criteria: Core: membership inference, i.e. deciding whether a specific record was in a model's training data: attacks, defenses designed against them, or privacy audits and evaluations that use them.
Any model type counts: classifiers, generative models and LLMs, graph models, federated and recommender systems.

Out of scope: other privacy attacks studied alone (model inversion, attribute inference, model or data extraction) with no membership inference; differentially private training that never evaluates membership inference; general adversarial robustness.
